sentences.sentence: The NHS knee pain page lists causes including sprains and strains, tendonitis, torn ligaments, tendons or meniscus, a dislocated kneecap, bursitis, gout and Osgood-Schlatter's disease.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: Search text for the NHS page lists sprains/strains, tendonitis, torn ligaments, tendons or meniscus, dislocated kneecap, bursitis, gout (with septic arthritis in same row), Osgood-Schlatter's. Osteoarthritis and 'cartilage' not seen in retrieved text.

sentences.sentence: The NHS knee pain page links sprains and strains to overstretching, overusing or twisting the knee, often during exercise.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: Retrieved text links sprains/strains to overstretching, overusing or twisting, often during exercise; no 'often causes sudden knee pain' statement seen.

sentences.sentence: An NHS trust leaflet lists pain, stiffness after rest and swelling as symptoms of osteoarthritis.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: Newcastle leaflet text retrieved lists pain, stiffness after rest and swelling; loss of movement and deformity not seen.

sentences.sentence: NHS inform says the exact cause of knee osteoarthritis is unclear, and risk factors include ageing, a previous knee injury, being overweight and family history.
sentences.note: Summary of knee osteoarthritis results (NHS inform page first). | second pass: supported

sentences.sentence: An NHS trust page says changes seen on an X-ray do not necessarily match how bad the symptoms are.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: NHS inform not shown saying this. An RJAH NHS trust page says over half of people over 65 show changes on X-ray but this does not necessarily correlate with symptoms; 'very mild or none' overstated; attribution wrong.

sentences.sentence: NHS inform says strengthening the muscles around the knee helps manage osteoarthritis symptoms.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: NHS inform: strengthening muscles around the knee helps manage symptoms. Thigh strengthening comes from Leeds and Royal Berkshire trust leaflets. 'Exercise does not speed up the arthritis' not found.

sentences.sentence: The NHS says knee pain can often be treated at home by reducing weight on the knee, using an ice pack and taking painkillers such as paracetamol or ibuprofen.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: Main NHS advice: reduce weight on knee, ice pack, painkillers. The tea-towel, 20 minutes every 2 to 3 hours detail came from the NHS 111 Wales page, not nhs.uk, and other trusts give different timings; paracetamol/ibuprofen listed as standard options.

sentences.sentence: Hampshire and Isle of Wight NHS guidance suggests seeing a GP if knee pain has not eased within a few weeks.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: Not confirmed as nhs.uk text; retrieved wording came from Hampshire and Isle of Wight NHS guidance (GP visit suggested if not eased within a few weeks). Attribution changed.

sentences.sentence: The NHS says people may be able to refer themselves to community musculoskeletal (MSK) physiotherapy services without seeing a GP.
sentences.note: Returned search text for this page said this (summary blends pages). | second pass: supported

sentences.sentence: An NHS trust leaflet describes physiotherapy as the mainstay of treatment for pain at the front of the knee.
sentences.note: Returned search text for this page said this (summary blends pages). | second pass: supported

sentences.sentence: An NHS trust leaflet on hip and knee osteoarthritis describes regular exercise, over-the-counter pain relief and losing a small amount of body fat.
sentences.note: Edited after second pass: Newcastle leaflet text retrieved covers regular exercise, paracetamol/NSAIDs and losing a small amount of body fat; footwear not seen there.

sentences.sentence: The NHS advises calling NHS 111 if the knee is badly swollen or has changed shape, or if there is a very high temperature with redness or heat around the knee, which can signal infection.
sentences.note: Returned search text for this page said this (summary blends pages). | second pass: supported
